rev.t: It's true that they don't refund the deposit. They forcefully take it away, when you move out, especially if your startup is not doing well and they don't think you can be a potential customer for them again. …
Avoid them at all costs. There are much better vendors providing quality furniture at the same cost. …
Good for startups that need very limited space with a head count less than 15 otherwise it's super difficult to share a washroom among 15+ folks.
